test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 Oct 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A certain number of people are sitting in a row, facing north. Only two people sit between R and S. P sits to the immediate left of R. T sits second to the right of S. Q sits second to the left of P. U sits second to the right of T. If no other person is sitting in the row, what is the total number of persons seated?
solution:
**Given: **A certain number of people are sitting in a row, facing north.

1) P sits to the immediate left of R.

2) Q sits second to the left of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d35185a33da42d765db0587c3989d7ad1bf12a255500ef3e5395808a238765d.png] 

3) Only two people sit between R and S.

4) T sits second to the right of S. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88ac6986725a09e31c6c6ec251c0cea5eae98e0b0da60a48dac763cab631412c.png] 

5) U sits second to the right of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0cabc952ace47cbbb45c2f97ef05b1f334c9910e32c7ef26b5112c769e718b1.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, 11 people are sitting in a row.

Hence, **"Option 1"** is the correct answer.
